name: SCN_OF_MUTE_ANIM_SOUND
meaning: animation sound events not played (0x50d540); set by Wolf/Sheep in some states

name: SCN_OF_HIDDEN2
meaning: with 0x800: not rendered, ignored by proximity queries (mask 0x804; Scn_RenderIfVisible 0x55ffe3 skips the object). Set by ObjectManager_SetObjectsActive 0x4da187 on deactivate: keepUpdating == 0 gives flags = (flags & 0xbfff) | 0x2004; keepUpdating != 0 sets flags = 4 outright. Was also spelled SCNOBJ_SKIP_RENDER_4

name: SCN_OF_KEPT
meaning: inventory item committed at checkpoint (survives restart)

name: SCN_OF_NO_PLANE_CULL
meaning: the near/frustum view-plane test in Scn_RenderIfVisible / RenderAll is skipped (the distance test still applies). Was also spelled SCNOBJ_IGNORE_CULL_PLANE

name: SCN_OF_CINE_UPDATE
meaning: keeps updating when tagged 0x80 in cinematic mode

name: SCN_OF_NO_DIST_CULL
meaning: exempt from the 9000000 dist2 cut in tinted render / several class updates

name: SCN_OF_NO_BOX_COLLIDE
meaning: box test skipped (unless query flag 0x20); interact scan uses point distance

name: SCN_OF_HIDDEN
meaning: not rendered and skipped by proximity queries; this is the bit cinematic opcodes 4/5 toggle (Cine_OpToggleObjectFlag 0x562fc0 = cinematic HIDE/SHOW). Was also spelled SCNOBJ_HIDDEN

name: SCN_OF_INITIALISED
meaning: initial value set by both Inits; no reader found (inferred)
